dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Amiri came into ACC as a stray. Because of this, we do not know how she would do in a home environment. Amiri has been noted to be highly fearful and at times not allowing pick up. Amiri has been observed to flinch and move back when she notices people walking behind her. She is noted to walk with little to no leash pressure. Amiri is also observed to resource guard toys by becoming tense and hovering above the toy. She was observed to body block the assess a hand during her assessment. We recommend placement with a New Hope partner who can provide any necessary behavior modification (force-free, positive reinforcement-based) and re-evaluate behavior in a stable home environment before placement into a permanent home.
dog.name: Amiri
